root_cause.text: Missing of_node_put for the DMA master OF node in rzn1_dmamux_route_allocate when a route allocation failure occurs after the node reference is taken, specifically on the -EBUSY branch from test_and_set_bit.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a new label `put_dma_spec_np` that calls `of_node_put(dma_spec->np)` before the existing `free_map` label, and changes the `goto free_map` on the EBUSY error path to `goto put_dma_spec_np` to ensure the reference is dropped. The commit message explicitly states: "Make sure to drop the reference taken to the DMA master OF node also on late route allocation failures."
